cleaning_notes: 'Entire population' sheet: header row 1, units row 2, 150 dog rows; reading stops at the first blank ID. The authors' summary rows below the data (medians with ranges, counts) were not read as data; they are used as checks.

IDs with a note in the cell were cut to the ID: BET023 (B. rossi + E. canis); BET072 (B. rossi + E. canis); BET100 (B. vogeli); BET147 (B. rossi + E. canis). The notes give the infection (also in the PCR columns).
2 dogs have no CBC or biochemistry (BET065 and BET066 in the file).
Respiratory rate 'P+' (panting, 24 dogs) is null in resp_rate and 1 in panting.
sex and neuter split from the SEX column (MALE INTACT, FEMALE SPAYED, ...).
MCHC converted from g/dL to g/L (x10).

FLAG (kept as reported): one dog (BET048 in the file) has red cell count 7.89 x10^12/L, the same number as its WCC, while its haematocrit is 0.28 L/L and MCV 75.5 fL (HCT/MCV gives about 3.71 x10^12/L). Probable entry error in rbc.
FLAG (kept as reported): one dog (BET021 in the file) has globulin 1 g/L while total protein minus albumin is 32.7 g/L. Probable entry error in globulin.

The habitus grade and the authors' derived classes (anaemia, WCC, bands, left shift, monocytes, ARC, globulin, illness duration) are in the outcomes file only: earlier work used them as severity proxies. Habitus 'COLLAPSED' (3 dogs) is coded 0 in habitus_score; habitus_raw keeps the text.
Haematocrit agrees between the two sheets for all dogs except 0.
One dog is B. vogeli only (pcr_b_vogeli = 1, pcr_b_rossi = 0); 3 dogs are B. rossi + E. canis. They stay in the file with group 'infected'; filter on the PCR columns.
The old DS05 tidy file (git 8d4c6d9) was used as a reference for column meanings only.
Floating-point noise in the cells was rounded to 10 decimals.
